findings: All eighteen geometry views personally inspected. Camera canisters meet the box; metal patch is flat; retained shutter lifts above the aperture; winder meets take-up spindle.

Soil cutaway deliberately removes foreground earth. Bulb is upright below surface with basal roots. Rear soil occludes bulb from rear; visible front half communicates a diagram, not an above-ground planting.
Glass outline exposes soda and immersed spoon. Bowl is below liquid; the visible narrow handle can read as a straw, recorded as recognition limitation. Bubble annotations are enlarged.

Five native-size light/dark candidate cards, nine custom/Noto reference cards and ten actual IconManager variants personally inspected. No clipping or broken anatomy; no human figure is used. Labels resolve medium, camera type, specific bulb and research meaning.

Current organizer calendar shows Tulip Planting November 7, 10–4, with November 8 related occurrence. Bulb planting inferred from tulips and autumn timing, supported by RHS; no supplies or planting depth supplied by event page.

Primary horticultural reference read: dormant bulbs planted in autumn, pointed end uppermost, depth proportionate to bulb height. Art is explicitly a cutaway with simplified dimensions, not planting instructions.

Current 14th Street Y program read: participants make coffee and fruit-syrup sodas and egg-cream floats; sorbet demonstration is a separate component. Generic nonalcoholic soda mixing avoids narrowing the whole program to one recipe.

Primary research class covers evaluating sources, checking facts and online images/video, scholarly sources and archives. Icon represents evaluation activity and does not endorse source claims about search tools or certify truth.

Creator tutorial specifies a standard matchbox, film frame cutout and black interior. Original model uses a simple rectangular light-tight box.
Flat thin metal aperture plate; approximately 0.2mm working aperture. Illustration enlarges its mark to remain visible and has no optical lens.
A card slides in a sleeve taped on three sides; raised card exposes aperture. Model retains card between two side rails and a lower rail.
Film runs from feed canister through matchbox to take-up canister, with canisters flush against the box.
Canister/box connections must be sealed; model closes those connections and leaves spindle/winder available.
Take-up winder rotates spool; original model uses a simple attached bar rather than copying ring-pull artwork.
